TemplateFilenameItemData.description:
The `zt` root of the `filename` template: an item's own
{@link TemplateItemBaseData}, its collections, and inert `notePath` /
`noteLink` stubs. The note-body context is absent — no `backlink`,
`weblink`, `annotations`, `attachments`, `relatedItems`, `authors`,
`authorsShort`, or `notes` — so naming a note stays a single-item read.

members.name: notePath
members.description:
Always `""` — the note does not exist yet when a filename is resolved.
Stubbed (rather than omitted) so a filename template that references
{@link TemplateItemData.notePath} does not throw; matches
{@link TemplateItemData.notePath}'s `string | null` contract.

members.name: noteLink
members.description: Always returns `""`; matches {@link TemplateItemData.noteLink}'s signature.

members.name: collections
members.description: Collections the item belongs to, sorted by name; trashed collections excluded.

members.name: key
members.description: Zotero item key, e.g. `"ABC12345"`; unique within its library.

members.name: groupID
members.description: Group library ID; `null` for the personal library.

members.name: libraryID
members.description: Zotero library ID holding the item.

members.name: indexedKey
members.description: {@link key} for the personal library, `KEYgGROUPID` for a group library.

members.name: itemType
members.description: Zotero item type, e.g. `"journalArticle"`, `"book"`.

members.name: dateAdded
members.description:
When the item was added to Zotero. Second precision — Zotero stores the
timestamp as a UTC string with no sub-second component. Renders as the
local date (e.g. `2026-06-21`) in `{{ }}` output.

members.name: dateModified
members.description:
When the item was last modified in Zotero; same precision and rendering as
{@link TemplateItemBaseData.dateAdded}.

members.name: creators
members.description: Every creator on the item, in Zotero's own order.

members.name: primaryCreatorType
members.description:
The creator role Zotero treats as primary for this item type, e.g.
`"author"` for a journal article, `"director"` for a film; `null` when the
type defines none.

members.name: tags
members.description: Tags applied to the item.

members.name: title
members.description: Item title.

members.name: abstract
members.description:
Abstract text. The CSL-inspired rename of Zotero's `abstractNote`, which
stays accessible — both `zt.abstract` and `zt.abstractNote` work.

members.name: containerTitle
members.description:
Journal or container title. The CSL-inspired rename of Zotero's
`publicationTitle`, which stays accessible — both names work.

members.name: citationKey
members.description: Citation key, from Better BibTeX or Zotero's native citation key.

members.name: citekey
members.description: Alias for {@link citationKey}; both stay accessible on `zt.*`.

members.name: date
members.description: Publication date, parsed from Zotero's multipart `date` field.

members.name: shortTitle
members.description: Short title.

members.name: DOI
members.description: Digital Object Identifier.

members.name: url
members.description: Item URL.

members.name: ISBN
members.description: ISBN.

members.name: ISSN
members.description: ISSN.

members.name: volume
members.description: Volume.

members.name: issue
members.description: Issue.

members.name: pages
members.description: Page range.

members.name: publisher
members.description: Publisher.

members.name: place
members.description: Place of publication.

members.name: edition
members.description: Edition.

members.name: language
members.description: Language, verbatim as Zotero stores it, e.g. `"en-US"`, `"English"`.

members.name: extra
members.description:
Parsed best-effort from Zotero's free-text `extra` field; prints `raw`.
`null` when the field is empty or absent.

additional.description:
Item-type-specific Zotero fields beyond the typed ones above, each under
its canonical name — e.g. `zt.conferenceName`, `zt.numPages`. A field
Zotero maps to a base field is reachable through that base name alone:
read `blogTitle` as `zt.publicationTitle`, `studio` as `zt.publisher`,
`reportNumber` as `zt.number`, `thesisType` as `zt.type`.

TemplateCollection.description:
A Zotero collection an item belongs to, in the template vocabulary. Coerces
to `name` in string contexts (like a tag coerces to its name).

members.name: key
members.description: Zotero collection key.

members.name: name
members.description: Collection name.

members.name: path
members.description:
Ancestor chain from top-level root to this collection: `path[0]` is the
top-level ancestor, `path[path.length - 1]` is this collection. A plain
array — render with `path.join(" > ")` (or `"/"` for filename folders), or
pipe the collection list through the `collection_paths` filter, which
joins each full ancestor path by a separator (`"/"` by default).

TemplateCreator.description:
One creator of an item, in the template vocabulary. Coerces to
{@link TemplateCreator.fullName} in string contexts.

members.name: family
members.description: Family / last name; empty for institutional creators.

members.name: given
members.description: Given / first name; empty for institutional creators.

members.name: literal
members.description:
Full name for institutional / single-name authors (Zotero `fieldMode=1`);
`null` for personal names.

members.name: role
members.description: Zotero creator type: `"author"`, `"editor"`, `"translator"`, etc.

members.name: fullName
members.description: `literal` for institutional creators, `"given family"` for personal names.

TemplateTag.description:
A Tag in the template vocabulary. Coerces to `name` in string contexts (like a
collection coerces to its name), so `{{ zt.tags | join: ", " }}` renders tag
names directly. Zotero-internal IDs are dropped; `type` is the resolved name
rather than {@link ItemTag}'s raw int.

members.name: name
members.description: Tag name as shown in Zotero.

members.name: type
members.description:
`"manual"` for a hand-added tag, `"auto"` for an automatic one (a
translator or plugin attached it while saving or importing); `"unknown"`
for a type id Zotero added after this mapping was written.

Year only. Also covers Zotero's `01 2003` misparse where the user-string day
is meaningful but month is missing (the spurious day is dropped since no
`Temporal` type fits "year + day without month").

ItemExtra.description:
Best-effort structured view of Zotero's `extra` field. Plain data so it is
directly indexable in Liquid, Eta, and JS.

`toString` is non-enumerable, so a spread, `JSON.stringify`, or
`Object.keys` sees the three data properties alone.

members.name: raw
members.description: Original field text verbatim, for a full round-trip.

members.name: fields
members.description:
First value per key — the common-case lookup, e.g.
`zt.extra.fields["tex.mendeley-tags"]`. First-wins: a repeated key keeps
its first occurrence.

members.name: lines
members.description:
Every source row in order, the source of truth {@link ItemExtra.fields}
derives from. Scan it to recover every value of a repeated key.

ExtraLine.description:
One source row of an Extra field, in document order: a parsed pair (`key`
plus trimmed `value`) or a non-pair text/blank row (`key: null`). `raw` is the
verbatim line so interleaved prose is never dropped.

A line splits on its first `:` or `=`, and is a pair only when the key starts
with an ASCII letter and otherwise holds ASCII letters, digits, spaces, dots,
hyphens, or underscores. A line that does not match, and one whose value is
empty, becomes a text row.

A non-enumerable `toString` returns `raw`, same mechanism as {@link ItemExtra}.

members.name: raw
members.description: Verbatim source line.

members.name: key
members.description: Parsed key, trimmed.

members.name: value
members.description: Parsed value, trimmed; always non-empty on a pair row.

members.name: raw
members.description: Verbatim source line.

members.name: key
members.description: Always `null` — prose, blank, and empty-value rows carry no key.
